home.slideSellerTitle: Find groceries and other products in your city
home.slideCargoTitle: Find cargo vehicles heading to Nigeria and send your goods
home.slideTorontoTitle: The Platform made for Entrepreneurs to do business
home.subtitle: Create a Free Account, post and promote your products and services, find cars going to Nigeria to send your cargo home.
home.slideSellerAlt: A smiling seller in a colourful head wrap and apron, standing in a Nigerian grocery store in Canada
home.slideCargoAlt: A silver Toyota Sienna packed with luggage and boxes, being loaded into a shipping container at a port
home.slideTorontoAlt: A smiling professional in a winter coat and scarf, with the Canadian flag and the Toronto skyline in the background
home.banner2Title: Get a free website After Referrals
home.banner4Title: Send goods home with cargo cars
home.placeholderNote: Placeholder content: final wording to come.
home.testimonialBody: Sample testimonial: real customer feedback will appear here once it has been collected.
home.faqMoreTitle: Have a question about a product?
home.faqMoreBody: Every product page lets you contact its seller directly.
home.faq1Q: Do I need an account to browse?
home.faq1A: No. Anyone can browse listings without registering.
home.faq2Q: How do I contact a seller?
home.faq2A: Open a product and use its contact form. You can send a message without creating an account.
home.faq3A: The seller's identity has not been verified yet. The label appears on their products so that you can decide with that in mind.
home.faq4A: Biqbaq currently serves Nigerians in Canada, with all prices in Canadian dollars. Each listing shows where its seller is based.
home.faq5Q: How do I become a seller?
home.faq5A: Register, then apply for a seller role from your account. Each application is reviewed before it is approved.
